|game_text=Deploy on [Virtual Block 4] [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers{{!}}Hidden Base]]; you must choose alien/[Independent Starship] starship. You may not deploy Ellorrs Madak, [[Revolution]] or operatives. [[Your Destiny]] is canceled. Opponent generates no Force at Hidden [[Jakku: Landing Site{{!}}Landing Site]]. [Virtual Block 1] [[Yerka Mig (V){{!}}Yerka Mig]] may deploy on a Rebel Cell Site, may be placed in Used Pile if it was just canceled, and you may retrieve Force with it only once per turn. While [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers{{!}}Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]] on table, attrition against opponent is +1 for each Rebel Cell site you occupy with an alien. [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Underworld Contacts & •Uncharted Settlements (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 8.3 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image print this text (the Master List slip prints the later text). No published image shows the errata text; [[Underworld Contacts & •Uncharted Settlements (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-02-Underworld_Contacts_Uncharted_Settlements-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.3 release sheet (official text as of 28 March 2013; copy re-made 3 April 2013): “Deploy on [Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base; you must choose alien/[Independent Starship] starship. You may not deploy Ellorrs Madak, Revolution or operatives. Your Destiny is canceled. Opponent generates no Force at Hidden Landing Site. [Virtual Block 1] Yerka Mig may deploy on a Rebel Cell Site, may be placed in Used Pile if it was just canceled, and you may retrieve Force with it only once per turn. While Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers on table, attrition against opponent is +1 for each Rebel Cell site you occupy with an alien. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf Virtual Block 8.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 28 March 2013"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095533/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Underworld Contacts & •Uncharted Settlements (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 30) changed “if it was just canceled” to “if it was just lost”: “Deploy on [Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base; you must choose alien/[Independent Starship] starship. You may not deploy Ellorrs Madak, Revolution or operatives. Your Destiny is canceled. Opponent generates no Force at Hidden Landing Site. [Virtual Block 1] Yerka Mig may deploy on a Rebel Cell Site, may be placed in Used Pile if it was just lost, and you may retrieve Force with it only once per turn. While Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers on table, attrition against opponent is +1 for each Rebel Cell site you occupy with an alien. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
